Wolfram|Alpha · Site Nav BIBLE § NAV · one component for product and marketing · 2026-09-08

This page is the nav's source of truth for developers. The component is nav.css plus the markup below; every colour, size and spacing is a token from design-system/styles/alpha-tokens.css, and the two Pro buttons are the shared .btn .btn--sm; rows, items and menus are the shared .row / .sheet-row / .nav-item / .menu primitives from alpha-base.css, sized by the --row-* tokens. Resize this window to see the live bar re-tier; the bands below pin every breakpoint and state at 1:1.

Signed out: the two Pro buttons take the PRO slot and lead the row, then APPS, SIGN IN, theme. Signed in: PRO menu, APPS menu, account, theme — no buttons. No TOUR item anywhere. Only the bar height (56 → 48), the gutter (24 → 16) and the logo (24 → 20) re-tier, at 767.
